status: Retained native IPC annotation and coverage repair. Configured DRC, selected consumer, capability-cost and full-fixture gates pass. The complete properties.md goal remains active.
scope: apply_ipc356_nets, ipc356_coverage and their CLI/benchmark callers. The previously repaired ipc356_drill_diameter operation is relocated without changing its body apart from measurement import paths. Other IPC, point/copper and geometry paths remain open.
contract: Both annotation and coverage use NativePointSpatialIndex with certified native enclosures, source-index retention and conservative fallback for unavailable bounds/radii. Checked squared native distances decide closed-radius matches.

apply_ipc356_nets now returns Result<(), PcbGeometryUncertainty>. It stages borrowed metadata and applies updates only after the outer STRICT/budget guard returns success. All board nets and drill diameters remain unchanged on required numeric failure. Error source identity is retained.

Existing values and first matching records retain priority; zero replacement diameters remain eligible for later replacement. Required copied diameters must be certified nonnegative. Unneeded matches and far/missing diameter replacements do not require irrelevant certificates.

The CLI propagates typed annotation failure before running checks or emitting a readiness report. A real parsed KiCad/IPC regression checks error downcasting and absence of the requested report summary. Successful prior boards in a multi-board local preparation are not rolled back; failure prevents the run from reporting that preparation as complete.

Coverage accepts any certified match even when another candidate is unresolved. If no match is proved, unresolved candidates remain uncertainty; required missing-point report projection is fallible. ReadinessRunner preserves a blocking Uncertain receipt.
IPC operations share the private checks/board/ipc module while checks::board and checks re-exports preserve public paths. Annotation callers must now handle the typed result.
Implementation version advances from 10 to 11; schema remains 1. Each of six Easyduino snapshots changes only its 160 implementation-version fields.
